title: Anything a player might type (foundation §4.2)
description: Every answer or secret word ships with its variants. All lowercase. The pack test normalizes every entry (§4.3), fails on any clash between entries, fails when an `accept` does not match `exact`, and warns under three accepted forms for a common word (aim for six or more where they honestly exist).

id.description: Stable forever (recaps, flags, overrides key on it).

accept.description: Same answer: plurals, common misspellings, US/UK spellings, abbreviations, with/without spaces and hyphens, true synonyms, brand vs generic.

reject.description: Looks close but is wrong; blocks a fuzzy match (cat for car, puffin for penguin).

family.description: Word games only: roots that give the secret away as a clue (sunflower → sun, flower).
